Hi Emily,

We were in the meeting room for the 10:00 AM slot and didn’t see anyone join. Lauren and Sean stayed on for ~15 minutes in case you were delayed.

Can you confirm whether legal still wants a live walkthrough or if you'd prefer us to share written responses to the redlines? If you want a live sync, please share 2–3 windows next week that work for both procurement and legal. We can scale to a 60-minute meeting if your counsel needs extra time.

Also attaching the SOW again and a short one-pager that calls out the three clauses we usually see pushback on.

Proposed next-week windows (ET):
- Tue 11/23: 11:00–12:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed 11/24: 09:00–10:00

If none of those work, suggest alternatives and we’ll do our best to accommodate.

Regards,

Our in-house counsel (cc’d) would prefer a full 60-minute session to walk through the redlines — there are a few items they want to discuss live (data residency, indemnity carveouts, and the SLA credit ladder). I attached the internal redline markup for context; some of the language is RFH (redline-for-review) from our side.

Available times from legal:
- Tue 11/23: 11:00–12:00 ET — tentative
- Thu 11/25: 10:00–11:00 ET
- Fri 11/26: 15:00–16:00 ET

If you can hold Tue 11/23 11:00–12:00, that would be ideal. Otherwise propose alternatives and we’ll confirm.

Thank you for following up and for the summary doc.

—Emily
Emily Cho

emily.cho@lakeviewhealth.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Emily Cho <emily.cho@lakeviewhealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-17T09:02:10-05:00
Subject: Re: missed: Contract redline review — quick follow-up

Emily — thanks for the update and totally understand. We’re happy to expand to 60 minutes. I pulled together a short mutual action plan so the call is focused and we can close the outstanding items in one session.

Proposed MAP for the 60-minute legal review (Tue 11/23 11:00–12:00 ET):
- 00–10 min: introductions & scope (who signs, billing entity, SSO/KMS ownership)
- 10–35 min: redline walkthrough (data residency, indemnity, third-party access)
- 35–50 min: remediation/mitigations and timeline (SLA credits, escrow, audit windows)
- 50–60 min: action items & DocuSign path (who will own sign-offs and target dates)

I’ve attached a two-page summary of the redlines and proposed compromise language for the indemnity and data-residency clauses — these tend to unblock procurement faster. If your counsel prefers different language, please paste it into the meeting chat so we can capture it live.

Available seats from our side: Vanessa (AE), Sean (Solutions Engineer), and me (Legal liaison). If you confirm Tue 11/23 11:00–12:00 ET, I’ll send an updated calendar invite with an agenda and a DocuSign prep link for pre-reads.

Lauren Bishop
Legal & Contracts | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redline_summary_2pg.pdf (PDF)]

See you on Tue.
—Emily
